occ.birthday.name: Birthday a ni
occ.birthday.headline: Birthday lawmna hun hmang rawh
occ.birthday.message: Kum hlimna, hriselna tha leh hlawhtlinna nena khat kum khat hmang turin duhsakna ka hlan e. I duhthusam zawng zawng kha lo thleng rawh se.
occ.anniversary.name: Inneihna kum khat tlin lawmna
occ.anniversary.headline: Anniversary lawmna hun hmang rawh u
occ.anniversary.message: In pahnih hian dam chhung inhmangaihna, inpumkhatna leh hlimna nei turin duhsakna ka hlan a che u. He milestone mawi takah hian lawmthu kan sawi e.
occ.wedding.name: Inneihna tur
occ.wedding.headline: Nupa Nun Hlim Tak
occ.wedding.message: I inneihnaah thinlung takin lawmthu kan sawi e. In zin dun chu hmangaihna, inrintawkna leh hlimna tawp nei loin khat rawh se.
occ.work-anniversary.name: Hnathawh Champha lawmna
occ.work-anniversary.headline: Hnathawh champha lawmna hun hmang rawh u
occ.work-anniversary.message: Kum khat dang inpekna leh hnathawh ropui tak kan neih avangin lawmthu kan sawi e. Team tana in rawn ken zawng zawngah lawmthu kan sawi e.
occ.business-anniversary.name: Sumdawnna kum khat tlin lawmna
occ.business-anniversary.headline: Business Anniversary lawmna hun hmang rawh u
occ.business-anniversary.message: Kum hlawhtling dang kan hmang leh ta a, kan lawmpui hle. In rinna leh thawhhona avangin lawmthu kan sawi e — hetah hian kum tam tak chhunga hmasawnna tur a awm.
occ.inauguration.name: Dawr / Office hawn a ni
occ.inauguration.headline: I bul tanna thar hi kan lawmpui e
occ.inauguration.message: Grand opening-ah duhsakna kan hlan e. I hmalakna thar hian hausakna, hmasawnna leh hlawhtlinna ropui tak thlen rawh se.
occ.congratulations.name: Kan lawmpui e
occ.congratulations.headline: Kan lawmpui e
occ.congratulations.message: I hlawhtlinnaah thinlung takin lawmthu kan sawi e. I thawhrimna leh i inpekna hian min tichak tak zet a ni.
occ.thank-you.name: Lawmthu kan sawi e
occ.thank-you.headline: Lawmthu kan sawi e
occ.thank-you.message: In rinna leh in thlawpna chhunzawm zel avangin lawmthu kan sawi e. Kan bula i awm avangin kan lawm tak zet a ni.
occ.get-well-soon.name: Dam thuai rawh
occ.get-well-soon.headline: Dam thuai rawh
occ.get-well-soon.message: Dam leh thuai turin duhsakna ka hlan e. Fimkhur la, hriselna tha takah lo kir leh thuai rawh.
occ.housewarming.name: In lumna (Griha Pravesh) 1.1.
occ.housewarming.headline: Griha Pravesh chungah lawmthu kan sawi e
occ.housewarming.message: In thar i neih avangin lawmthu kan sawi e. Remna, hmangaihna, hlimna leh hausaknain khat rawh se.
occ.new-baby.name: Naute thar
occ.new-baby.headline: Kan lo lawm e, Little One
occ.new-baby.message: I hlimna bundle te tak te lo thleng hi thinlung takin kan lawmpui e. Naute dam chhung hriselna leh hlimna nei turin duhsakna hlan.
occ.retirement.name: Retirement lawmawm tak a ni
occ.retirement.headline: Retirement lawmawm tak a ni
occ.retirement.message: Career ropui tak i neih avangin lawmthu kan sawi e. Nun bung thar thlamuang, hrisel leh hlimawm tak hmang turin duhsakna kan hlan a che u.
occ.best-wishes.name: Duhsakna sang ber kan hlan e
occ.best-wishes.headline: Duhsakna sang ber kan hlan e
occ.best-wishes.message: Hlimna, hriselna tha leh i thiltih apianga hlawhtlinna tur duhsakna kan hlan che u a ni.
occ.new-year.name: Kumthar a ni
occ.new-year.headline: Kumthar chibai kan buk e
occ.new-year.message: He Kumthar hian beiseina thar, remchang thar leh hlawhtlinna tam tak rawn thlen che u rawh se. Nang leh i chhungte tan kum ropui tak lo awm turin duhsakna ka hlan e.
occ.republic-day.name: Republic Day ni a ni
occ.republic-day.headline: Republic Day chibai kan buk a che u
occ.republic-day.message: Kan Constitution thlarau leh Indian kan nihna chhuanawmna hi i lawmpui ang u. Jai Hind a ni.
occ.independence-day.name: Independence Day a ni
occ.independence-day.headline: Independence Day chibai kan buk a che u
occ.independence-day.message: Zalenna min petu pasalthate chibai bukna. Kan hnam hi chakna leh inpumkhatnain a thang zel ang u. Jai Hind a ni.
occ.gandhi-jayanti.name: Gandhi Jayanti chuan a rawn ti a
occ.gandhi-jayanti.headline: Gandhi Jayanti chungah lawmthu kan sawi e
occ.gandhi-jayanti.message: Hnam Pa hriatrengna. Thudik leh tharum thawhna tel lo a thil tumte chuan min kaihruai fo ang che.
occ.ambedkar-jayanti.name: Ambedkar Jayanti chuan a sawi
occ.ambedkar-jayanti.headline: Ambedkar Jayanti chungah lawmthu kan sawi e
occ.ambedkar-jayanti.message: Kan Constitution siamtu Dr. B. R. Ambedkar chawimawina hlan. Intluktlanna leh dikna a thlirna hian min fuih rawh se.
occ.kisan-diwas.name: Ram pum huapa loneitute ni (Kisan Diwas) .
occ.kisan-diwas.headline: Kisan Diwas lawmawm tak a ni
occ.kisan-diwas.message: Kan hnam hnungzang, kan loneitute chibai bukna. Kan zavaia min chawmtu i thawhrimna avangin lawmthu kan sawi e.
occ.teachers-day.name: Zirtirtu Ni
occ.teachers-day.headline: Zirtirtu Ni lawmawm tak a ni
occ.teachers-day.message: Min kaihruaitu, min fuihtu leh kan hmalam hun min siamsak avangin lawmthu kan sawi e. Zirtirtu Ni lawmawm tak a ni.
occ.childrens-day.name: Naupangte Ni
occ.childrens-day.headline: Naupangte Ni hlim takin hmang rawh u
occ.childrens-day.message: Naupang tinte hlimna, thiam loh chantirna leh hmalam hun eng tak lawmna. Naupangte Ni hlim takin hmang rawh u.
occ.womens-day.name: Hmeichhe Ni
occ.womens-day.headline: Hmeichhe Ni chibai kan buk e
occ.womens-day.message: Khawi hmunah pawh hmeichhiate chakna, khawngaihna leh hlawhtlinna lawmna. Hmeichhe Ni chibai kan buk e.
occ.mothers-day.name: Nute Ni pual a ni
occ.mothers-day.headline: Nute Ni hlim takin hmang rawh u
occ.mothers-day.message: Hmangaihna leh ngaihsakna tawp nei lo petu hnenah — Nute Ni hlim takin hmang rawh u.
occ.fathers-day.name: Father's Day puala hman tur a ni
occ.fathers-day.headline: Father's Day lawmpuina hun hmang rawh u
occ.fathers-day.message: Kan chakna leh kaihhruaina lungphum — Father’s Day hlim takin.
occ.doctors-day.name: Ram pum huapa Doctor-te Ni
occ.doctors-day.headline: Doctor te Ni lawmpuina hun hmang rawh u
occ.doctors-day.message: Mihringte tana in inpekna, in ngaihsakna leh rawngbawlna avangin lawmthu kan sawi e. National Doctors' Day chibai kan buk a che u.
occ.friendship-day.name: Thian nihna Ni
occ.friendship-day.headline: Thian nihna Ni hlim takin hmang rawh u
occ.friendship-day.message: Thian ropui tak i nih avangin lawmthu ka sawi e. Hetah hian kan inzawmna leh hriatrengna hlimawm tak tak tam tak a awm.

occ.diwali.headline: Diwali chibai kan buk e
occ.diwali.message: Eng kût hian nang leh i chhungte tan hausakna, hlimna leh hriselna ṭha tak thlen rawh se.
occ.dhanteras.name: Dhanteras a ni
occ.dhanteras.headline: Dhanteras lawmawm tak a ni
occ.dhanteras.message: Pathiannu Lakshmi leh Lal Dhanvantari te chuan hausakna, hriselna leh hausaknain malsawm che rawh se.
occ.diwali-padwa.name: Diwali Padwa / Balipratipada ah hian a awm a
occ.diwali-padwa.headline: Diwali Padwa lawmna hun hmang rawh u
occ.diwali-padwa.message: Hmangaihna, hlimna leh hlawhtlinna nena khat bul tanna thar hlawhtling tak nei turin duhsakna ka hlan che u a ni.
occ.bhai-dooj.name: A rilru a buai em em a. Bhai Dooj / Bhaubeej
occ.bhai-dooj.headline: Bhai Dooj hlim takin
occ.bhai-dooj.message: Unaute inzawmna hlu tak lawmna. Hmangaihna, venhimna leh hlimna duhsakna hlanin.
occ.holi.name: Holi a ni
occ.holi.headline: Holi hlim takin hmang rawh u
occ.holi.message: Holi rawng nung tak takte chuan i nun chu hlimna, hmangaihna leh hausaknain luah khat rawh se.

occ.navratri.headline: Navratri lawmna hun hmang rawh u
occ.navratri.message: Heng zan duhawm 9 chhung hian Maa Durga chuan chakna, finna leh hlimnain malsawm che rawh se.

occ.ganesh-chaturthi.headline: Ganesh Chaturthi chungah lawmthu kan sawi e
occ.ganesh-chaturthi.message: Lal Ganesha chuan i kawng a daltu zawng zawng paih bo la, finna leh hausaknain malsawm che rawh se. Ganpati Bappa Morya chuan a rawn ti a.
occ.raksha-bandhan.name: Raksha Bandhan chuan a rawn ti a
occ.raksha-bandhan.headline: Raksha Bandhan lawmna hun hmang rawh u
occ.raksha-bandhan.message: Unaute inkara hmangaihna leh venhimna inzawmna mawi tak lawmna.

occ.janmashtami.headline: Janmashtami chibai kan buk e
occ.janmashtami.message: Lal Krishna chuan i nun chu hmangaihna, hlimna leh Pathian malsawmnain tikhat rawh se.
occ.makar-sankranti.name: Makar Sankranti chuan a rawn ti a
occ.makar-sankranti.headline: Makar Sankranti chibai kan buk e
occ.makar-sankranti.message: He buh seng kût hian i nunah thlum, lumna leh hausakna rawn thlen rawh se.

occ.maha-shivratri.headline: Maha Shivratri lawmpuina hun hmang rawh u
occ.maha-shivratri.message: Lal Shiva chuan thlamuanna, chakna leh hlimnain malsawm che rawh se. Har Har Mahadev chuan a rawn ti a.

occ.ram-navami.message: Lal Rama malsawmna chuan thutak, felna leh hlimna thlen che u rawh se.
occ.hanuman-jayanti.name: Hanuman Jayanti chuan a rawn ti a
occ.hanuman-jayanti.headline: Hanuman Jayanti chungah lawmthu kan sawi e
occ.hanuman-jayanti.message: Lal Hanuman chuan huaisenna, chakna leh inpeknain malsawm che rawh se.

occ.vasant-panchami.message: Pathiannu Saraswati chuan hriatna, finna leh thil siam chhuah thiamna hmangin malsawm che rawh se.

occ.karva-chauth.name: Karva Chauth

occ.karva-chauth.message: Hmangaihna leh inpumkhatna nena khat Karva Chauth malsawmna dawng turin duhsakna ka hlan e.
occ.chhath-puja.name: Chhath Puja a ni
occ.chhath-puja.headline: Chhath Puja chibai kan buk e
occ.chhath-puja.message: Chhathi Maiya leh Ni Pathianin nang leh i chhungte hriselna leh hausakna malsawm rawh se.
occ.nag-panchami.name: Nag Panchami a ni
occ.nag-panchami.headline: Nag Panchami chibai kan buk e
occ.nag-panchami.message: He ni thianghlim hian venhimna, remna leh hausakna thlen che u rawh se.
occ.tulsi-vivah.name: Tulsi Vivah a ni
occ.tulsi-vivah.headline: Tulsi Vivah chibai kan buk e
occ.tulsi-vivah.message: Tulsi leh Lal Vishnu te Pathian inzawmna chuan in in chu hlimna leh inrem takin malsawm rawh se.
occ.eid-ul-fitr.name: Eid al-Fitr a ni a
occ.eid-ul-fitr.headline: Eid Mubarak a ni
occ.eid-ul-fitr.message: He Eid hian nang leh i hmangaihte tan remna, hlimna leh hausakna thlen rawh se.

occ.eid-ul-adha.message: Allah malsawmna chuan i nun chu hlimnain luah khat sela, hlawhtlinna kawngkhar zawng zawng chu hawng rawh se.

occ.christmas.headline: Krismas hlim takin hmang rawh u

occ.easter.name: Easter hman a ni
occ.easter.headline: Easter hlim takin hmang rawh u
occ.easter.message: Easter hlimna leh beiseina chuan i thinlung leh in in luah khat rawh se.

occ.guru-gobind-singh-jayanti.name: Guru Gobind Singh Jayanti chuan a rawn ti a

occ.guru-gobind-singh-jayanti.message: Guru Gobind Singh Ji huaisenna leh finna hian min fuih vek rawh se.
occ.buddha-purnima.name: Buddha Purnima a ni
occ.buddha-purnima.headline: Buddha Purnima lawmna hun hmang rawh u

occ.mahavir-jayanti.name: Mahavir Jayanti chuan a rawn ti a
occ.mahavir-jayanti.headline: Mahavir Jayanti chungah lawmthu kan sawi e

occ.baisakhi.name: Baisakhi a ni

occ.gudi-padwa.name: Gudi Padwa chuan a rawn ti a
